questions.text: Which US president's face appears on the penny?
questions.explanation: Lincoln has appeared on the one-cent coin since 1909.

questions.text: In which city is the White House, the president's official residence?
questions.explanation: The White House stands at 1600 Pennsylvania Avenue in Washington, D.C.

questions.text: Who was the first President of the United States?
questions.explanation: Washington took office in 1789 after the Constitution was ratified.

questions.text: The Declaration of Independence was adopted in which year?
questions.explanation: Congress adopted the Declaration on July 4, 1776.

questions.text: Robert E. Lee surrendered at Appomattox Court House, effectively ending which war?
questions.explanation: Lee surrendered to Ulysses S. Grant in April 1865.

questions.text: In 1803, the United States bought the Louisiana Territory from which country?
questions.explanation: Napoleon's France sold the territory to Jefferson's government.

Which president resigned from office in August 1974?

questions.text: Abraham Lincoln's Emancipation Proclamation took effect in which year?
questions.explanation: It was issued as a war measure effective January 1, 1863.

questions.text: Who was the first president to live in the White House?
questions.explanation: Adams moved into the unfinished building in November 1800.

questions.text: Alaska was purchased from Russia in 1867 during the presidency of whom?
questions.explanation: Secretary of State William Seward negotiated the deal for President Johnson.

questions.explanation: Chief Justice John Marshall ruled in Marbury v. Madison.

questions.text: Which US president served the shortest term in office, dying 31 days after his 1841 inauguration?
